svg.title: Controlled evidence study and diagnostic contrasts
svg.desc: An editable study schematic. The main QASPER experiment uses a shared BGE-M3 and BM25 retrieval pool, four selectors, three complete-input limits, and fixed Qwen2.5 deployments. Only dependencies differ in the density-closure pair. Five independent reviewers assess 180 main-test outputs. Three complementary studies isolate training-split planner activation, whole-paragraph human-evidence selection headroom on the previously evaluated QASPER test questions, and order alone on independent LongBench examples. Human annotations supply input only in the post hoc oracle diagnostic. The study contains 7,600 distinct responses, including 400 new oracle and 800 LongBench responses; reused controls do not add observations.

g.text: 1,200 development + 4,800 main test + 400 planner follow-up + 400 oracle + 800 LongBench
